observedBehavior: The realtime database page is a workbench list plus three Win32 Button controls.
新增对象 inserts a default row in the list; it does not open a modal dialog immediately.
对象属性 opens the 数据对象属性设置 dialog for the selected row.

baseControls.writeMethod: set-text --paste; old MFC Edit controls need EM_SETSEL + WM_CLEAR + WM_PASTE

controlBinding.nameEdit: Edit width 110..150, left column, first row
controlBinding.initialEdit: Edit width 110..150, left column, second row
controlBinding.unitEdit: Edit width 110..150, left column, third row
controlBinding.noteEdit: wide Edit under 对象内容注释

enabledCommand.verification: exports Data table and checks exact strName

automationNotes: Use PostMessage or mouse fallback for workbench buttons; BM_CLICK alone may not trigger every MFC path.
After add, select the new row and open 对象属性 to set name/type/note.
Enabled workflow creates one object per run; batch add remains a separate future workflow.
Do not save during profiling; use a copied .MCE.
